annotations.title: Share with someone outside the workspace

description: Mint a share code for a tag (a label or a project) - a private link for someone outside the space. `tag` is a tag id or name; `label` records who it is for (required). Optionally set `expires_days` to time-box it (0 = never), so a leaked link does not stay live. Optionally set a `pin` (4-8 digits) as a second factor: the link then reaches a PIN prompt, not content, so a forwarded link alone is not access - send the PIN by a different channel (phone/text). The holder opens the returned `url`, enters the returned `code`, and can then view that tag's collections and comment/approve as `label`. Internal tags cannot have share codes.

expiresDays.description:
expires_days time-boxes the code: after this many days it stops admitting,
 so a leaked link does not stay live until someone remembers to revoke it.
 0 (the default) means it never expires.

label.description:
label records who the code is for (required) - it identifies the holder's
 comments and approvals.

pin.description:
pin optionally sets a second-factor PIN on the code (#364): the link admits
 only after the holder also enters this PIN, sent by a different channel. 4-8
 digits, not an obvious sequence. Empty (the default) means no PIN. Never
 returned after creation. It can be added or changed later with set_share_pin.

space.description:
space optionally selects which of your spaces to act in (an id or name
 from list_spaces). Omit it when you belong to a single space.

tag.description:
tag is the tag (a label or a project) to mint the code for - an id, or a
 name in the acting space. A share code admits its holder to that tag's
 collections; internal tags cannot have share codes.

name: create_share_code

code.description: code is the secret the holder enters at `url` to be admitted.

expired.description: expired is true when expires_at has passed (the code no longer admits).

expiresAt.description: expires_at is when the code stops admitting; unset means it never expires.

hasPin.description:
has_pin is true when the code carries a second-factor PIN (the PIN itself is
 never returned).

label.description: label records who the code is for - it identifies the holder's feedback.

locked.description:
locked is true when the code is locked out after too many wrong PINs; it
 admits nobody until unlocked.

revoked.description: revoked is true when the code has been revoked (no longer admits).

url.description:
url is the anonymous view page for the code's tag, where the holder enters
 the code. Absolute when the app base url is configured, else a /v path.
